discovery_context:
ADR numbering: read .claude/dev-team/memory/architecture-notes.md yourself to confirm current state, but as of this task's authoring: ADR-010 (D17 verdict blocks), ADR-011 (D16 noise filter), ADR-012 (enforcement layering, ratified 2026-08-01), ADR-013 (contract freeze structural, ratified 2026-08-01) are all in architecture-notes.md. So ADR-016 is the correct next number for this decision.

Exact citation sites to fix: scripts/cmux/record.mjs:541 (the throw message: 'is not implemented (see ADR-014 in architecture-notes.md) — the CLI turn ...') and references/cmux-dispatch.md:57 ('... by design (see ADR-014 in architecture-notes.md)'). Change both to ADR-016.

ADR-016 memory entry content (write into architecture-notes.md following the file's existing entry format/voice, dated same as other entries in that file): 'cmux pane mode has no turn budget, by mechanism, not by omission. {"continue": false} can only truncate a RUNNING agent loop, and the worker plugin (scripts/cmux/worker-plugin/hooks/hooks.json) ships exactly two hook events: Stop (fires after the loop has already ended) and UserPromptSubmit (fires only at kickoff, which must never block, and at a human interjection, which gate-mode.sh's own settled invariant says must never be force-stopped either). A Stop-based counter's entire delta over the existing gate.max_blocks counter is events it must not act on. The runaway/hang bound is therefore wall-clock timeout_s, parent-side (ladder.mjs, measured from record.created_at). max_turns stays in the frozen schemas as integer|null but is inert by refusal: buildRecord (and, as of #8's follow-up, dispatchCmd before any worktree/snapshot side effect) throws on any non-null value from any of its three sources (config override, role override, roster default); the --max-turns CLI-flag emission was deleted (it was already unreachable — roster default null, zero role overrides). Re-entry condition: a future probe showing claude --max-turns N is honored in interactive (non-print) mode would move enforcement to the CLI layer per ADR-012, never to a hook. Supersedes: the references/cmux-dispatch.md:57 promise of a future Phase-3 gate counter.'

Hoisting the check: scripts/cmux/dispatch.mjs's dispatchCmd currently resolves `const resolved = roster.roles[role]` at line 666, then does the workspace-liveness refusal (lines 688-698, the pattern to mirror), then derives attempt (line 708), then at lines 710-718 conditionally calls ensureWorktree if resolved.isolation === 'worktree', then unconditionally calls snapshotWorkerPlugin at line 722. resolved.max_turns (role override) and roster.defaults.max_turns and config.maxTurns are ALL available by line 666-708, before any of the worktree/snapshot side effects. Insert the max_turns check there, using the same three-source priority order buildRecord uses today (scripts/cmux/record.mjs:535-537: config.maxTurns !== undefined ? config.maxTurns : (resolved.max_turns !== undefined ? resolved.max_turns : roster.defaults.max_turns)).

Extract that resolution + throw into one function (suggested name: resolveMaxTurnsOrThrow({config, resolved, defaults}) or similar, living in record.mjs since that's where the logic currently lives and dispatch.mjs already imports from record.mjs) and call it from both dispatchCmd (early, before side effects) and buildRecord (as the existing backstop — buildRecord can just call the same function and keep using its return value for record.max_turns, which should always be null after the guard, but keep assigning it explicitly rather than assuming, for clarity).
